thread:
Priya Nair: opening a tiny PR to refresh our rate/quota examples to the v3 metering fields. plan: one short example for tiered billing, one for burst credits (reserve -> committed), a curl header example, and a tiny Python SDK snippet. tagging @Maria for header name and wording.
Maria Gomez: thanks. can we also include a short migration note for customers on Dedicated who still see the legacy header? suggest: 'If legacy header present, prefer /v1/usage as ground truth'.
Ben Liu: +1. Also add a PromQL line customers can paste into Grafana and a note about daylight-saving/timezone alignment.
Priya Nair: will do. thinking of header name `X-RW-Usage-Info` (json blob) in responses and `X-RW-Quota-Status` for quick numeric flags. please call out examples for 200 vs 429 handling.
Maria Gomez: prefer we show a real small response header example and a curl -I snippet. pseudo-header example:

    X-RW-Usage-Info: {"window_start":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","used_tokens":4200,"burst_reserved":500}

Ben Liu: for the Python SDK snippet keep it idiomatic and short. something like: 
```py
# read header or fall back to usage endpoint
hdr = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Usage-Info')
if not hdr:
    usage = client.usage.get_window()
else:
    print('usage header:', hdr)
```
Priya Nair: good. i'll also add a curl example showing 429 handling: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate 
# check X-RW-Quota-Status for "over_limit" and read body for 429 details
```
Jesse Kim: can you add a short acceptance checklist in the PR description: 1) swap headers in JS/Python/Go snips, 2) add migration note for Dedicated, 3) include promql + grafana panel alt text, 4) run link sweep. makes reviews faster.
Priya Nair: will add checklist. promql example I'll include: 

    sum by (plan) (rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total[5m]))

and a grafana panel alt text: "Stacked area showing token consumption by plan over rolling 24h window; x-axis UTC, y-axis tokens"

Maria Gomez: quick nit: please standardize on UTC examples in docs and call out local-time comparisons. we get support tickets when customers interpret `window_start` in local TZ.
Ben Liu: also include a small troubleshooting tip: "If header missing, likely proxy stripped it; ask customers to check ingress proxies or fallback to /v1/usage."

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/docs/metering-refresh-3668901234 (priya) :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: assigning reviewers @Maria and @Ben. after two approvals i'll merge and run the internal link crawler + submit a short playbook update to support.
Jesse Kim: I'll draft the release-note blurb: "docs: metering v3 examples, header guidance, and SDK snippets" and mark internal-only until legal OKs the public sample.
Maria Gomez: great. I'll review now and leave inline wording suggestions. try to keep examples <= 6 lines each.
Priya Nair: thanks all 609 will wait for comments and ping again if anything blocks. closing thread after merge.
